comics.subject: Bhagavad Gita
comics.logline: Arjuna drops his bow on the edge of war, and Krishna lifts his gaze from the dying self to the deathless Self, the path of action, and the vision of all worlds.
comics.time_span: the eve of the Kurukshetra war
comics.narrator: Sanjaya (the Gita's own frame; no Little Chanakya)

changelog.note: Volume 1 draft — 64 pages built act by act (frame · collapse · the deathless Self · karma yoga · the widening vision · the cosmic form · close). Verse spine copied verbatim from the GRETIL Sanskrit; Easwaran translation beneath; attributed notes; Gandhi and Oppenheimer interludes cited via Davis. No Little Chanakya; the Gita's own Sanjaya/Dhritarashtra frame. No Devanagari; no invented scripture or quotes.

comics.narrator: Sanjaya (the Gita's own frame; no Little Chanakya)

changelog.note: Volume 2 draft — 64 pages built act by act (bridge/re-entry · the way of love, Ch 12 · the field and the knower, Ch 13 · the three forces, Ch 14–15 · the two natures and faith, Ch 16–17 · the supreme secret of surrender, Ch 18 · the transformed return).
